# Zhilly

> Zhilly is a small social hostel with a café in Kalimpong, West Bengal, India (the Darjeeling hills, about 1,250 m up). One mixed dorm with eight beds (four bunk beds) and one private room with a queen bed and its own bathroom, in a cottage among very tall trees at Lower Bong Basti, Kalimpong 734301. Run by Canopy Ventures, a partnership firm.

## Key facts

- What: a hostel (sometimes searched as a homestay) with a café. Guests 16 and over; no families.
- Where: Lower Bong Basti, Kalimpong, West Bengal 734301, India. Map: https://www.google.com/maps?q=27.058037,88.473698 (27.058037, 88.473698).
- Beds and prices (per night): dorm bed ₹800 with breakfast; private room ₹1,500 for up to two, or ₹1,700 with breakfast for two.
- Included: breakfast with dorm beds (10 to 10:30 am), bed linen, blanket and towel, hot water (geyser), internet at 40 to 50 Mbps, power backup for lighting and the internet.
- Check-in from 11 am, check-out by 10 am. ID at check-in: Aadhaar card, PAN card or passport.
- Café: open every day, 12 pm to 11 pm. Guests and day visitors welcome.
- Getting there: about 73 km from NJP railway station (about 2.5 hours on NH10 along the Teesta) and about 78 km from Bagdogra airport.
- How to book: pick dates in the calendar on any page of https://zhilly.life and send a booking enquiry, or message on WhatsApp +91 82933 26469 (https://wa.me/918293326469), or email zhilly.life@gmail.com. Zhilly replies with a quote; a UPI advance (half or all) holds the booking, and the rest is paid at check-out.
- Cancellation: 7 or more days before arrival, full refund; 3 to 6 days, half back; under 3 days or no-show, no refund. Dates can be moved once, free, with 7 or more days' notice.
- Contact: zhilly.life@gmail.com, WhatsApp +91 82933 26469. Instagram https://www.instagram.com/zhilly.life/, Facebook https://www.facebook.com/zhilly.life
